title_sq: Shitet, Vilë Individuale, West Home Residence, Farkë

West Home koncepton një stil të ri jetese, si ekuilibrues mes jetesës private-familjare dhe asaj socail-komunitare. Tipologjia A Tipi - A4 Vilat Elitare janë një nga tipologjitë më luksoze në West Home Residence Tipari i veçantë i vilës është privatësia e plotë me 3 dhoma gjumi, një dhomë gjumi master me pamje mbresëlënëse të pejsazhit dhe Tiranes. Vilat Elitare i japin vlerë të veçantë kompleksit rezidencial West Home. title_en: For sale, Individual Villa, West Home Residence, Farka
description_en: The West Home residential complex is located in Farke on Agallareve street with entrance and exit access to the big ring and overlooking Tirana, 14 minutes from the center of Tirana, 2 minutes from TEG and 5 minutes from Farka lake. West Home conceives a new lifestyle, balancing between private-family and social-community life. Typology A Type - A4 Elite Villas are one of the most luxurious typologies in West Home Residence. The special feature of the villa is complete privacy with 3 bedrooms, a master bedroom with impressive views of the landscape and Tirana. Elite Villas give special value to the West Home residential complex. Designed with 2 floors and a basement, the Elite Villas are designed for a functional organization with elegant spaces both inside and outside. Each villa has 3 dedicated parking spaces and a private pool.
